# Device frames

Source: https://github.com/picturepan2/devices.css

Selected the iPhone 14 Pro and MacBook Pro CSS rules from dist/devices.css; prefixed classes with no-device and omitted the global display:block reset so it does not override interactive prototype content. Responsive scaling and screen layout live in shared/prototype-devices.css and v8-home.js.
